Single Source of Truth Across the Project Lifecycle

  • A unified, real-time view of construction progress updated directly from mobile apps by the construction site teams

    • Get an eye on Management Blind Spots

  • Granular visibility of progress at different levels of WBS, ensuring no critical slippages, bottlenecks, or non-compliances go unnoticed.

    • Accountability Across Stakeholders

  • Drive clear accountability by mapping responsibilities, commitments, and performance to contractors, construction teams, and supported by system-recorded evidence.
